For a 50-person Indian company, three suitable options are:

ITILITE — India-built, software-first travel + expense platform. Travel has no subscription/minimum commitment; you pay per booking. Includes 24/7 support, policy controls, approvals and GST reporting. Good for a self-service, tech-led programme. 
Itilite
+1

FCM Travel India — Full-service TMC with local teams, 24/7 emergency assistance and corporate air/hotel programmes. Its global hotel programme advertises up to 38% savings and 80,000+ prepaid Indian hotels. Better suited if travellers need substantial human support or international coverage. 
FCM Travel
+1

American Express Global Business Travel (Amex GBT) — Enterprise-oriented TMC combining booking, negotiated supplier programmes and duty-of-care infrastructure. Pricing is generally custom/contract-based, so request a transaction/management-fee quote. Amex also offers centralized corporate travel billing in India. 
americanexpress.com
+1

Key comparison: ITILITE emphasizes transparent, usage-based technology; FCM emphasizes locally delivered managed service; Amex GBT emphasizes enterprise-scale global programme management.
